findings.note: Roll-call record shows an Aye vote on SB 921, Const. Am./Require Photo ID For All Voters (73-45). The bill text (S921v1) rewrites Art. VI Sec. 2(4) so that all voters, not only in-person voters, must present photographic identification. Second Reading vote the same day was also Aye.
subjects: ID with a mail or absentee ballot

findings.note: Roll-call record shows an Aye vote to concur on HB 958, Election Law Changes (62-47). Edition 4 of the bill includes provisions on identification for absentee ballots (photocopy of ID or affidavit as curable deficiency), ID when identification numbers do not match, and provisional ballots without photo identification, and moves cure deadlines to the fifth business day. The same roll-call history shows Aye on Second Reading (2026-06-30, 66-47).

Roll-call record shows an Aye vote on HB 1074, Constitutional Amendment/Citizens-Only Voting (99-12). He also voted Aye on Second Reading (2024-06-26) and No on one amendment (A1 Harrison) the same day.

Roll-call record shows an Aye vote to override the veto of SB 747, Elections Law Changes (72-44). On 2023-08-16 he voted Aye on Second Reading (69-47) and No on 17 floor amendments (A1-A17), which failed. The bill text was not read for ID content, so only the title is recorded.
